title: A ReAct Agent in LangGraph
learning_objectives: Build an agent graph from a model node, a ToolNode and tools_condition
Limit the number of steps with recursion_limit
Keep conversations per thread with an InMemorySaver checkpointer
entry_point: build_agent(model, tools); run_agent(app, question, thread_id, max_steps=8)
hints: Bind the tools once outside the node function: `bound = model.bind_tools(tools)`.
Edges: START → agent, conditional edges with tools_condition, tools → agent; compile with `checkpointer=InMemorySaver()`.
The config is `{"configurable": {"thread_id": thread_id}, "recursion_limit": max_steps}`; read `result["messages"][-1].content`.

failure_feedback.advice: Route with tools_condition and add an edge from tools back to agent.
Compile with InMemorySaver() and pass the thread_id in the config.
Use ToolNode(tools), which reports tool errors as messages.
